title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt

meta.Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: Outside the Farm

rows.Speaker: Assistant Director
rows.Line: Rolling in three, two...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's time for another installment of “Hey! Check Out This Town!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
T-Today, we're on the scene!
We're the idol group that's been getting a lot of buzz on social media! MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...! Thank you all so much!
Hehe. So, let's begin by explaining what this segment's all about!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This segment involves traveling to various places and taking a closer look at the lives of the locals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. And today, we get to be a part of the local elementary school's field trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A field trip...? What will we be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember this part, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Picking vegetables!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Cooking curry!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Excellent! Both answers are correct!
I'm glad you all remembered.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, with the help of our friendly farmers here, we'll be learning about how various vegetables are harvested.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we're going to use those veggies to whip up some curry!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, what a wonderful field trip...
You get to pick, cook and eat your own vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, let's dive right in.
Everyone, let's do our best and pick lots of yummy veggies!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
That concludes today's shoot.
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Thank you for doing today's segment, ladies. I have a good feeling about this installment. I mean, the children all looked so happy.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: The teachers also wanted me to give you their thanks. Children can easily get distracted, but you did a wonderful job of maintaining their interest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, we should be the ones thanking them.
This shoot ended up being a lot of fun because the children were all so full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
That's great to hear!
I'm hoping that we can work together again in the future.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Oh, we should probably get going soon. Especially all of you since you have school tomorrow, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for keeping an eye on the time.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
Again, thank you all very much for today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you as well!
Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we managed to catch the train!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The travel has been hectic, but we should be able to get home by this evening now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but MORE MORE JUMP! doing a shoot in the countryside... I was a little worried since it was our first time doing anything like this, but I'm glad it went so well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. And it sounds like they want us back... I'm glad we agreed to do this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Definitely!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not only that, picking veggies and cooking curry with everyone from that elementary school was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori, you sure went for a tumble while trying to pull out those carrots.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm pretty sure that was caught squarely on camera.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! Really?!
That's so embarrassing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but the show couldn't have asked for more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: T-True...! So, that makes us lucky!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The children's energy was so infectious that I'm sure none of us could stop smiling. I have a really good feeling about this shoot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we've received a ton of other offers too! That means we just gotta keep trying more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's true. Between interviews for magazines, radio appearances, paid promotions for our streams and... What else was there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There were also some other TV offers like the one for today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's like we're in a dream.
I can't believe we're being given so many offers...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We started receiving more after our solo show, but...the TV offers in particular have been a recent development.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
iHaz definitely had a huge impact.
I think that's led to everyone in the showbiz world starting to recognize us for who we are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so nice that all these people are hearing about us and hoping to work with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You contributed a lot to our big break, Shizuku. You should be more proud.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you gave that speech on iHaz and totally nailed it, you won over a ton of people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! So many people on social media were talking about what you said afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I was really nervous at the time, but I'm so happy that everyone understood how I felt...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that means we gotta keep doing everything we can to spread hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sleepy, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been at it nonstop since early this morning. I can see why you're tired. Go ahead and get some shut-eye. I'll wake you up when we reach the station.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You will?! Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How do you feel, Haruka, Shizuku?
You two can go to sleep too if you want.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm okay for now.
There's actually something I still need to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We have a history quiz tomorrow and I want to study a little for it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I have that too!
What do I do?! I completely forgot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I haven't studied for it at all, but I really need to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, instead of sleeping, I'm gonna study! Haruka, can I take a look at your textbook?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I think I'll stay awake as well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't mind them.
You don't have any tests or quizzes to worry about, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but if they're going to study, I'd like to be productive as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is there anything work-related that needs doing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Work-related...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go through the DMs and emails? There's just too many for one person to handle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku, you take the DMs.
Do you remember how to get to them? You tap here to move to the next message...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I think I remember!
Just leave it to me, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't say that I'm not worried, but they're in your hands now. Don't hesitate to ask if you have any questions, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I promise to try my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Now, the emails...
Oh, we've received a few more since I last checked this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This one's... A guest appearance on a radio program. It's only for a short segment, but it says they'll play our song for us.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This would be a chance to get it heard by more people.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, but they want to meet with us about it in the afternoon during the week...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(We can't because of school...
Still, it might be worth asking if they can meet on a different date...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's great to be receiving all these offers, and I'd like for us to accept as many of them as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But we also have our streams, practice and school, so taking them all on just doesn't seem doable.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What can we do about this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (For now, I'll start by taking another look at our schedule.)
The next day
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've tried adjusting our schedule a few different ways, but it just doesn't seem like we'll be able to accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As much as I don't want to, we're gonna have to turn a few of these people down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? A new email...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from that radio program.
I asked them yesterday to see if they can change the meeting date, but let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not really possible, huh?
I guess their producer's also pretty busy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would've been a nice opportunity to get our song out there, but we don't really have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm gonna have to politely turn down their offer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait a second...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku and I could conceivably make it...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Unlike Haruka and Minori, we're credit-based, which means we don't always have to be at school.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But the four of us have always done everything together as MORE MORE JUMP! Would it be okay for us to go without them...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, it's not like we have a rule saying that we have to do absolutely everything together...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I think all of us being present has made it easier to share responsibilities and move as a unit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (At the same time, as we keep receiving offers, we won't be able to keep doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If we want to be given more opportunities in the future, it might be best to have even just one of us appear...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which means it'd be best to take advantage of the freedom allotted to us by the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I can't make this decision on my own. We need to discuss this as a group...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hi, Shizuku?
Sorry, I know it's late. Are you free to talk right now...?
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about asking you to meet during lunch like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's fine... But you said there's something you wanted to talk about. Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, things are fine... But where do I begin?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Last night, while I was at home, I took another look at our schedule and made some adjustments. I've also already spoken to Shizuku about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Adjustments to our schedule?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We've had the fortune of receiving offers from various different people lately, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we only have a finite amount of time available to us, which means we're having to turn more and more down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I began wondering if there's a way for us to not have to do that as much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You've been doing all that for us, Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I had an idea and talked with Shizuku about it. Would you two mind taking a look at this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our schedule...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...? Hang on...
There's stuff here for weekday afternoons now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's just you and Shizuku, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how we're in the credit-based course? I was hoping we could take advantage of that and adjusted our schedule accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right. This would definitely allow us to accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do agree that we should accept whatever offers we can, even if all four of us can't be there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, a lot of people out there want to see us together. As such, I'd like to be careful about which offers we do accept.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. This is just a preliminary idea. Just one solution for addressing how we may or may not accept more offers moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I wanna hear what you think...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How do you feel about this, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me...? Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I believe that we're gonna need to take on as many of these offers as we can if we're going to achieve our goal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I think Shizuku and I should take advantage of the freedom that the credit-based course affords us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right. I agree.
However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want to force you and Shizuku to carry a heavier burden than us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure how I'd feel about you two working while we're at school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I wouldn't worry about that.
After all, this is for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, being at school doesn't mean you have nothing to do, y'know...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's plenty you can do here, right? For example, coming up with ideas for our stream in between classes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we go with this new scheduling scheme, we're gonna need you two to start handling more of those kinds of things. So, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Y-Yeah! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, we should do what we can...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Again, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll start putting together a new schedule with what we just discussed in mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Each day's gonna start to feel a lot busier as we take on all these new offers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let's do our best!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(We have math class after this...
But our meeting for that radio program is this afternoon. I should start getting ready.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last left school during the middle of the day like this. It's just like old times...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Before I stopped being an idol, I was constantly going back and forth between school and work. I hardly had any time to hang out with my friends...)
Hey, Airi, wanna hang out after school? I just heard about this shop that has these amazing cakes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, I can't today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Some not-so-happy memories are also popping into my head. But for now, where's Shizuku at...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! We gotta get going soon. You ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I'm ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's good to hear. It's just the two of us today, so we really gotta have our act together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since we'll need to be able to explain to Minori and Haruka about how our appearance is gonna go and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry, I plan on taking notes while we're there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You came prepared.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it is a little sad that Minori and Haruka can't join us today. Until now, the four of us did just about everything together...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I know how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they promised to do what they can on their end, so we also gotta produce some good results...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!
After school

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing me the class log, Kiritani. And good work today. I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
It's almost four. Airi and Shizuku should be returning from their meeting right about now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I wonder how it went.
I hope their staff is friendly.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You never really know until you actually meet them, so maybe I should've also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No, stop...
I can't keep thinking that I should've gone with them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(We left this up to them.
And I'm sure they'll ask all the right questions in our place.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I were still in the credit-based course like before, we may've been able to accept more offers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A message...?
From Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I wanna hammer out the details for this idea. Can you help me?>
I see. She's been working on what Airi asked...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (For the time being... I should do what I can to help her.)
Several dozen minutes later
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, this looks good...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“What's In Our Bags?!”
I think it's gonna be really fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really? Thank goodness!
To be honest, this idea just came from me wanting to see what's inside your guys' bags.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That ability to see things from a fan's perspective is one of your best qualities, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You think so? Hehe...
But thanks for working on this with me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad this idea came together so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Next, we can...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're hungry already?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, hehe... Actually, I didn't eat lunch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My plan was to come up with some ideas while I ate, but I ended up getting totally lost in thought.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nice to see that you're working hard, but you also need to eat right. Physical fitness is one of your biggest assets as an idol, so always keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But, well, I was getting really antsy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Antsy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... I kept thinking about how Shizuku and Airi were working while we were in class...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I started thinking that I can't just sit around... I have to do what I can in their place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I do agree with what Airi said! There's still plenty for us to do while we're at school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just can't help thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka...
You were in the credit-based course before, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can you tell me how classes and stuff work for that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, there are some key differences compared to the classes we take as regular students...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The biggest one being that... You don't have to always attend.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Naturally, in order to receive credit, you need to keep your attendance up and pass your tests.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you can more or less decide when or how much you show up. As such, it becomes easier to work in the afternoon during the week.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I have to ask, Minori...
Are you thinking about switching to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Umm...
I'm still not even sure...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But seeing what Airi and Shizuku can do...
I want to do more to help them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
If I... If all of us were credit-based, not just Airi and Shizuku, we'd be able to do more as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, exactly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, again, getting any schoolwork done will become just that much harder. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Switching to the credit-based course also means switching to a completely different lifestyle.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A different lifestyle...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. You won't be going to school every day like you do now. Which means spending less time with your friends...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It can't really be avoided, but it's one of the sad realities of this system...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, Haruka...
Is this coming from personal experience?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. For the longest time, I wasn't able to participate in many school events because of work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I always felt this distance between myself and my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if I did make a friend, I wouldn't see them very often... Most times, we'd just end up drifting apart.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, I'm not saying that the same thing is going to happen to you, Minori. It's just one possibility that I thought you should be aware of.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I've seen it all before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, Haruka, there's no need for you to apologize!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still... You're right.
It's clear that I need to give this more careful thought.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Going credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She still seemed a little unsure, but Minori's seriously considering it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (As for what Minori should do, she sort of has to figure that out herself. But...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's no question that I'd be able to do more as an idol if I went back to being credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In that case...)
The next day - After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it's earlier than usual, but I wonder if the others are already gathered on the rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Shiho and Kohane... And Minori, too. Right, they're all in the same class.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Bye bye, Minori!
Let's check out that new cafe sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That includes you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, relax.
I'm not about to break my promise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Bye bye, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're so close...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Huh? What happened...?
She looks really concerned now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're heading up to the rooftop for practice, right? Let's go together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, was something the matter?
You looked lost in thought there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's this thing that's been on my mind lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something that's been on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... Actually, Airi, would you mind if we talked about it for a second?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, go ahead. Lay it on me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line:
Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I agree with Haruka that the credit-based course has lots of advantages since it gives people like us a chance to work more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But at the same time, I don't think I've been able to see things from the other perspective she gave...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I don't have prior experience working as an idol like the rest of you, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've always had friends and classmates around me, and they'd give me their support whenever I told them that I wanted to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You want to become an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
Good luck. I'll be rooting for you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After we formed MORE MORE JUMP! and started putting on events in real life, including our solo show, I had a little less time to talk to or see my classmates... But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry! I'm having a meeting with Haruka and the others during lunch today...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*

But thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right.
So, Minori, good luck with your solo show. I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane... Shiho...
Thank you both so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They've been there by my side this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if I switch to the credit-based course, what Haruka said might actually happen. A gap might start forming between me and my friends...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think my mind has been able to fully comprehend how painful that might be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I need to give this decision more thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori's been thinking seriously about what she might lose if she were to go through with this...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And I believe that step is absolutely necessary.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Not only is your lifestyle gonna get turned on its head...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it happened to me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see. I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I agree with Haruka on this one...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In simple terms, switching to the credit-based course will allow us to do more as MORE MORE JUMP! But you'll sorely regret it if you leap before you look...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Because...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori has Shiho, Kohane and a ton of other close friends.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If possible, I don't want her to experience what I did back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But Minori's been seriously thinking about what she and we can do as MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This decision is ultimately up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for talking with me about this, Airi! I'm gonna keep giving it some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Line: I believe that the bonds friends establish are no different from one's feelings.

rows.Line: Yes. When people form relationships, they always do so by developing some manner of feelings for one another...

rows.Line: What those feelings are depends on their situation... For example, two friends may want to be kind to each other...

rows.Line: Once those feelings have been firmly established, it seems unlikely that they'll fade easily, even if you were to wish to get rid of them.

rows.Line: They don't fade...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I take it you two know what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The desire to spread hope to others as idols. That feeling never left us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. Even though I once thought it faded away completely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See? That's why I believe the bonds you forged with your friends are just as stubborn.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just as you still possess feelings for them, Airi, I'm sure they also still feel the same way about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, I agree with what he's saying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because how wonderful would it be if you found a way to rekindle the friendships with the people you've become estranged from after all these years...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, even if something were to happen that meant you and I ended up drifting apart...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that the warm kindness I sense in you would never really go away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even if I were to forget all about it, I know I'd remember in time. So, I think things are going to turn out just fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just like our feelings, the bonds we've forged never really fade or break...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna believe that too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
KAITO, everyone, thanks for listening to my story.
I'll take what I just learned and try thinking about this some more.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And good luck, Airi.
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See? That's why I believe the bonds you forged with your friends are just as stubborn.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just as you still possess feelings for them, Airi, I'm sure they also still feel the same way about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, I'm sure he's right.
Those kinds of feelings don't just disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I mean, just look at me...
I still feel awful about what happened with Ayumi.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There's no way I'd be filled with so much regret if those feelings were gone from within me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, if that's the case...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it okay for me to see for sure...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(If there is a way for me to check...
Would that change things?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Would it be like old times...?
Then, I'll be waiting in the courtyard! Don't take too long with whatever the teacher asked you to do, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Isn't that Ayumi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Here? Now? But why...? What are the odds...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(No, we go to the same school...
It's completely normal for us to spot each other from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because how wonderful would it be if you found a way to rekindle the friendships with the people you've become estranged from after all these years...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, even if something were to happen that meant you and I ended up drifting apart...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that the warm kindness I sense in you would never really go away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even if I were to forget all about it, I know I'd remember in time. So, I think things are going to turn out just fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Ayumi...!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: A-Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Umm... Long time no see. How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yeah, it's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, um... I, well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I called her name without really thinking... What am I supposed to talk about with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I... I was just wondering how you've been doing lately...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
How I've been doing...?
You know, the same old, same old...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Sorry for asking you out of the blue...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I don't know what to say next...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Does this mean things are never gonna be like old times...?)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Um, so... Airi, how have you been?
I know you've been really busy lately. Are you holding up okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I watch your streams from time to time. Everyone's been talking about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been watching...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Yeah, my friends told me about them.
You always look like you're having so much fun, Airi, and it really puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
Thanks. I'm so happy to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Of course! Also, I'm really glad for you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Remember how you took a break from being an idol? I was so worried for you then.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
But I guess that's too little, too late...
I really couldn't do anything for you back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that's not true... But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were that worried...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, we're friends, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that also sounds like just words... Before I knew it, we sort of stopped talking to each other...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... A gap began to slowly form between us after that field trip...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I didn't want to feel like a bother to you...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that led to talking to you less and less, which only caused us to drift apart more and more... Eventually, I felt awkward even just trying to start a conversation with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean for any of that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You were never a bother...
I was afraid of disappointing you by making promises I couldn't keep. It's my fault for not being more honest...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even back then, I kept wishing that I could hang out with you and the others more...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All the messages you sent me gave me a lot of encouragement too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But I never told you just how much that meant to me.
I'm really sorry, Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: No, please... You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I mean, Airi, you're here talking to me again, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Because you decided to come over, we're having a real conversation now.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: You worked up the courage to do what I was too scared to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I've been wanting to talk with you forever too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: We don't have to eat lunch or hang out together like we used to. I just want to stay friends with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Um...
Would it be okay if I started messaging you again?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I know we won't be able to hang out much and that I might be interfering with your work...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But I want to go back to having a real friendship with you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! Message me all you want!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might take me a while to respond, but I promise to always get back to you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And let's hang out again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like old times...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What happened? This feels so weird.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just a second ago, I thought none of this would be possible...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I didn't think it'd be this easy to see if there was anything left of our old friendship. But all I had to do was talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Airi, did that happen to you...?
Did you and your classmates become more and more distant because you were credit-based...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (How would I respond now if Minori were to ask me the same question...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yes, there's going to be some distance or awkwardness between you and your friends if you go credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But that doesn't mean all your relationships are gonna unravel or fall apart.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just don't give up... Believe in the bonds that you and your friends forged...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (All you need to do is work up a little courage and tell them how you really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Then, you'll get to keep being friends...)
A few days later - After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, Airi's here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here already. I thought I was gonna be the early bird.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but since we're all here now, shall we start our dance practice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, before we do...
Minori, there's something I need to tell you. Actually, I'd like for you all to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something you'd like to tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it has to do with Minori switching to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You knew, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I was the one who told her!
I decided to ask her about what you said, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, um... Airi...
What do you want to tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori, after we spoke that time, all this doubt started welling up inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I didn't want you and your friends to start drifting apart after you made the decision to go credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I asked KAITO and Shizuku about this, and even gave it some more thought on my own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As overbearing as this is going to sound, I want you to hear what I felt...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please, tell me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I told myself early on that switching to the credit-based course meant some gaps would form between me and my friends...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But KAITO explained how the bonds people form with one another aren't so easily broken.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: KAITO said that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. And the next day, I happened to see one of my old friends... So I went to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, how'd that go...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were both nervous about talking at first, so there was some awkwardness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But then, my friend said that she'd also been wanting to talk with me... That was when I realized that we both wanted to have a real friendship again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And now, we're messaging each other and talking like old times...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, Minori, I realized what I said to you wasn't entirely correct.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hold that you will need to make some sacrifices if you go credit-based, including spending less time with your friends. That's just unavoidable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Some may end up drifting away...
But I don't believe that's a reason to give up on them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like to answer your question again. But in a different way this time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The bonds you've forged with your friends won't easily break. The connections you've established with them will endure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It may not seem that way at times moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't want you to give up on them. You can always reset things by telling each other exactly how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all I wanted to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Airi.
I appreciate you telling us this story.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The truth is, I've been thinking a lot about what you and Haruka told me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I even asked the teachers about it and did a little research on my own about how I should proceed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I think I've found my answer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your story only reinforced my decision, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. We ended up making the same decision...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The same decision...? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also switching back to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because it's the best way for us to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, absolutely!
Let's spread lots and lots of hope together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's it. We're all going to be credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which means we'll be able to do even more as idols moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Juggling school and work each day won't be easy, and the relationships we have with our friends will also start changing.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm sure we'll have our share of problems to deal with...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I'm confident that we'll do just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. No, nothing's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Minori, you seem much more confident now compared to the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! That's because I gave this decision a lot of thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A lot of thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Minori?
Would you mind telling me more about what you did during that time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear too...
It'll be good for us to understand what your thought process was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...!
